thread:
marta: quick note — in logs I keep seeing clients flip region hints every few seconds, causing proxy churn and routing noise
jin: seen that too, it's spiking our route updates and triggering a couple of lease reacquires :/
noah: are these real client moves or just flaky hint generation on mobile SDKs?
sam: likely the SDK. our mobile library regenerates a hint from local geo + IP, sometimes oscillates when on cell handoff
marta: the problem is we treat hint changes as strong signals for soft-lease handoff. churn means a lot of unnecessary operator activity
jin: can we debounce at the edge? e.g. only act on hint change after N seconds or after stable sequence of same hint?
sam: yeah, debounce 30s seems safe for most clients. but for low-latency use-cases we might hurt correctness for legitimate movement
noah: proposal: three-layer approach: 1) sampling telemetry to classify hint instability per client-id 2) edge debounce default 30s, overridable by tenant 3) sticky-proxy fallback when tenant requests strict residency
marta: love that. telemetry piece is key — need a metric like "hint_entropy_per_client" and a histogram of fluctuation frequency
ops-bot: deploybot: canary rollout scheduled for edge-proxy v2.3.4 at 23:00 UTC :rocket:
jin: also add a policy: if hint flips between two nearby regions (e.g., us-west-1 <-> us-west-2) then prefer locality stability instead of immediate swap
sam: true — we should treat adjacency as soft-change, only escalate on cross-continent jumps or after N flips
noah: question: how does this interact with KV cache ownership / write leases? if we delay handoff, we might have writes routed to stale owner
marta: model: continue sending reads to owner; for writes, if proxy has hint but it's unstable, proxy should do a guarded write: attempt write to current owner, but if owner rejects with lease-mismatch, do an automated retry with new owner. that avoids eagerly moving the lease
jin: guarding writes with retry seems reasonable. add a 429/backoff pattern so we don't thundering herd on failover
sam: I'll sketch API changes: add header X-Client-Residency-Hint (string), X-Residency-Hint-Stability (enum: stable|flaky|unknown), and X-Residency-Debounce-Override (tenant-id or empty)
marta: perfect. telemetry team: can you add a dashboard for hint_entropy and a daily report of top flaky clients?
noah: I'll own the lease-safety doc updates. will include sequence diagrams for guarded-write path and fallback retry logic
jin: small nit — config names: "residency_hint_ttf" (time-to-fix) is confusing. prefer "residency_debounce_ms"
sam: agreed, use debounce ms and a per-tenant override in control plane
noah: ok I'll write an RFC follow-up and link example edge-proxy snippet: ```http
GET /generate
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Client-Residency-Hint: us-east-1
X-Residency-Hint-Stability: flaky
```
marta: thanks — let's also add a test harness to simulate oscillating hints in chaos suite
ops-bot: incidentbot: created ticket #INF-721 to track SDK hint flips and canary metrics
jin: great work team, I'll open PR for edge debounce + header support tomorrow :thumbsup:
sam: I'll coordinate with mobile SDK folks to include a stable-hint heuristic in next release
marta: ok closing the loop here — action items: telemetry dashboard (noah), RFC + doc (jin), edge debounce PR (jin), guarded-write doc (noah), mobile SDK change (sam). ping me if you need prioritization. :sparkles:
